item.elixir.handheld_fan.usage.1: §7Fan the furnace while refining to §6sharply raise§7 its heat
item.elixir.handheld_fan.usage.2: §7Fanning an unlit furnace lets it §5cool down§7
item.elixir.elixir_furnace.usage.1: §7Load herbs and a formula, ignite with §lFlint & Steel§r§7
item.elixir.elixir_furnace.usage.2: §7Keep heat near the target: §5too cold fails§7, §6too hot explodes§7
item.elixir.elixir_furnace.usage.3: §7Tune with a fan, surround with bricks, guard with the lid
item.elixir.alchemical_vessel.usage.1: §7Pour a water bucket to store three charges
item.elixir.alchemical_vessel.usage.2: §7Use on herbs to toggle their §5main/off property§7, one charge each
item.elixir.alchemical_vessel.usage.3: §7The main/off property decides how herbs sort in a formula; toggling changes the outcome
item.elixir.elixir_furnace_brick.usage.1: §7Lay around the furnace to §6improve refining stability§7
item.elixir.elixir_furnace_brick.usage.2: §7Each brick §6adds five stability§7; the more bricks, the steadier the flame
item.elixir.elixir_furnace_brick.usage.3: §7Stack a §b3×3~7×7§7 solid cube and right-click with a fan to form a Large Furnace
message.elixir_multifurnace.invalid: §cBrick structure incomplete; cannot form a Large Furnace (needs a solid 3×3~7×7 cube)
item.elixir.elixir_furnace_cover.usage.1: §7Place atop the furnace to guard the flame
item.elixir.elixir_furnace_cover.usage.2: §6Stability is preserved with the lid§7, keeping pills steady
item.elixir.material.desc.elixir.main.am: Summons lightning around all nearby creatures, yourself included (mod-added effect)
item.elixir.material.desc.elixir.main.an: Alters gravity, heavier or lighter (mod-added effect)
item.elixir.material.desc.elixir.main.bl: Strength when pharm is positive, Weakness when negative (vanilla effect)
item.elixir.material.desc.elixir.main.da: Dig Speed when pharm is positive, Mining Fatigue when negative (vanilla effect)
item.elixir.material.desc.elixir.main.di: Poison when pharm is positive, Wither when negative (vanilla effect)
item.elixir.material.desc.elixir.main.en: Invisibility when pharm is positive, Glowing when negative (vanilla effect)
item.elixir.material.desc.elixir.main.fe: Slow Falling when pharm is positive, Levitation when negative (vanilla effect)
item.elixir.material.desc.elixir.main.gh: Regeneration when pharm is positive, Poison when negative (vanilla effect)
item.elixir.material.desc.elixir.main.gl: Instant Health when pharm is positive, Instant Damage when negative (vanilla effect)
item.elixir.material.desc.elixir.main.go: Night Vision when pharm is positive, Blindness when negative (vanilla effect)
item.elixir.material.desc.elixir.main.gu: Explodes on the spot; blast grows with pharm (mod-added effect)
item.elixir.material.desc.elixir.main.la: Luck when pharm is positive, Unluck when negative (vanilla effect)
item.elixir.material.desc.elixir.main.re: Calls lightning onto yourself, taking damage (mod-added effect)
item.elixir.material.desc.elixir.main.ro: Saturation when pharm is positive, Hunger when negative (vanilla effect)
item.elixir.material.desc.elixir.main.su: Speed when pharm is positive, Slowness when negative (vanilla effect)
item.elixir.material.desc.elixir.off.bla: Auxiliary: adds a fixed 20 to the final pharm (mod-added calc)
item.elixir.material.desc.elixir.off.dir: Auxiliary: multiplies the final pharm by 1.2 (mod-added calc)
item.elixir.material.desc.elixir.off.red: Auxiliary: adds a fixed 75 to the final pharm (mod-added calc)
item.elixir.material.desc.elixir.main.bo: Summons fireproof zombies: positive pharm makes them fight for you, negative turns them against you; count scales with pharm
item.elixir.material.desc.elixir.main.ar: Dash along the X axis: +X when pharm is positive, -X when negative; range scales with pharm, capped
item.elixir.material.desc.elixir.main.ba: Dash along the Y axis: up when pharm is positive, down when negative; range scales with pharm, capped
item.elixir.material.desc.elixir.main.ch: Dash along the Z axis: +Z when pharm is positive, -Z when negative; range scales with pharm, capped
item.elixir.material.desc.elixir.main.pu: Dash toward where you are looking: forward when pharm is positive, backward when negative; range scales with pharm
item.elixir.material.desc.elixir.main.ph: Summons rings of fangs: positive pharm strikes outward at enemies, negative closes in on you; scale grows with pharm
config.elixir.title: Elixir Config
config.elixir.option.pharma_limited.tool: Pharma beyond this range has no effect
config.elixir.option.pharma_conversion_r: Final effect magnitude is divided by this
config.elixir.option.highest_pharma_limi: Pills above this pharma grade as §cExtreme+§r
Eating time at the pharma cap (supreme/top-grade pills); lower grades ease back toward the baseline by grade
config.elixir.option.dan_eat_mid_ticks.t: Eating time at zero pharma, close to vanilla eating speed; positive pharma gets faster by grade toward the fastest, negative pharma gets slower toward the slowest
Eating time at the pharma floor (worst/poison pills); deeper negative pharma approaches this value
When pharma exceeds the cap and the raw target temperature leaves the bar range (extreme case), clamp it this far from the edge; normal refining is left untouched
config.elixir.option.temp_safe_margin.to: Temperature cap = explosion line + this value; the explosion line always sits this far below the cap, and the fan can heat up to the cap; config-only, unaffected by experience
config.elixir.option.bad_elixir_compensa: Random pharma range for waste pills, multiplied by the pharma cap
config.elixir.option.stability_loss_rate: Exponentially affects the stability base of repeated materials
config.elixir.option.hud_scale.tooltip: Overall scale of the alchemy feedback HUD (temperature bar, stability bar, etc.); 1 is the smallest, up to 4x
config.elixir.option.max_furnace_size.to: Maximum edge length of the solid cube that forms a Large Furnace (starting from 3×3×3)
config.elixir.option.multifurnace_slots_: Material slots of a 3×3×3 Large Furnace; default 6
Material slots added per +1 edge length; default 3
Material slot cap; default 128, plenty for the largest furnaces
config.elixir.option.multifurnace_light_: Brightness of the light emitted by the four side-center bricks while a Large Furnace runs (0~15); 0 disables it
config.elixir.option.exp_success_gain.to: Experience gained for each successful refinement
config.elixir.option.exp_failure_gain.to: Experience gained for each failed refinement
config.elixir.option.exp_growth_rate.too: Steepness of the experience benefit curve; higher means slower growth, lower means faster
config.elixir.option.temp_range_base.too: Temperature tolerance at zero experience; experience increases it (scaled by growth rate)
config.elixir.option.temp_range_max.tool: Cap of the temperature tolerance experience can grant; approaches this value as experience grows
Ticks before overheating explodes at zero experience
Extra ticks experience can add to the explosion delay; approaches this cap as experience grows
config.elixir.option.failed_delay_base.t: Ticks before low temperature fails at zero experience
config.elixir.option.failed_delay_gain.t: Extra ticks experience can add to the cold failure delay; approaches this cap as experience grows
config.elixir.option.maid_exp_success_ga: Base experience a maid gains for each successful batch (separate from player experience, default 0.1)
config.elixir.option.maid_exp_failure_ga: Base experience a maid gains for each failed batch (default 0.1)
config.elixir.option.maid_negligence_cha: Chance (0~1) that the maid spaces out instead of acting on the furnace; higher means less reliable refining
task.elixir.alchemy.desc: With a handheld fan in the main hand, the maid will tend nearby Four-Aspect Furnaces: ignite them (skipping flint & steel), fan the heat, take the finished pill, and start the next batch, until the materials run out or the backpack is full.
chat_bubble.elixir.alchemy.backpack_full: Backpack full, no room for pills...
chat_bubble.elixir.alchemy.wait_player: No formula yet, waiting for you to light it~
chat_bubble.elixir.alchemy.formula_misma: Materials don't match the formula, checking elsewhere
chat_bubble.elixir.alchemy.empty: Nothing to refine here, looking for another furnace
item.elixir.dan_pouch.usage.2: §7Hold §b%s§7 in the main hand to open the wheel and pick; §eRight Click§7 to eat, Sneak + Right Click to throw
tooltip.dan_pouch.shift: Hold §eShift§r for the chosen pill's details
